This is where I document concepts as I work through the foundations of data science and machine learning.

These notes are part of my learning process. They help me organize ideas, test my understanding, and identify the gaps I need to work on. The goal is to explain concepts clearly in my own words, with the mathematics, reasoning, and examples that make them meaningful.

Not every note needs to be perfect. Some will evolve as my understanding improves.

## How I Write These Notes

When exploring a concept, I aim to answer a few questions:

* *What is it?* Define the concept clearly.
* *Why does it matter?* Understand the problem it helps solve.
* *How does it work?* Explore the underlying reasoning and mathematics.
* *Can I demonstrate it?* Use an example, calculation, visualization, or piece of code.
* *What do I still not understand?* Record questions to revisit.

The notes will grow alongside my understanding. I want them to become a useful reference for myself and, hopefully, for others learning the same concepts.
